bleeding: Do your gums bleed only when brushing/flossing, or does it happen spontaneously without touching?
How long have you noticed bleeding from your gums?
swelling: Is the swelling confined to a small gum area, or is it spreading to your cheek/face?
Do you feel warmth, fever, or noticeable throbbing around the swollen area?
pain: On a scale of 1 to 10, how intense is your tooth or gum pain?
Is the pain constant, or is it triggered mostly by hot, cold, or chewing?
structural: Do your teeth feel loose or wobbly when you bite down?
Have you noticed your gums shrinking or teeth looking noticeably longer?
infection: Is there any visible pus, discharge, or foul taste coming from the gum area?
Do you have a fever or difficulty opening your mouth?
sensitivity: Does the sensitivity linger for more than 30 seconds after cold or hot liquids?
Do you feel sharp pain near the root or gum line?
systemic: Do you have a history of diabetes or regular tobacco/smoking use?
When was your last professional dental checkup or scaling?
general: How many days or weeks have these symptoms been present?
Are you experiencing any other discomfort in your teeth or gums?
